rca_of_issue: v5.0.2 user reports mapped to two root causes: (a) BACKEND — the fallback dict introduced in v5.0.1 only listed etf/stock_us/gold_silver/commodity/forex, so any market whose active profile had an empty symbols list (stock_id under the 'spot' profile which has stocks=[]) returned an empty column; v5.0.3 fix adds crypto/stock_id entries, covering all 7 markets. (b) FRONTEND chat — the TextInput had no explicit color prop, so on some Android themes the text color resolved to placeholder/transparent making typed text invisible; additionally, tapping send while keyboard was open caused blur+re-render race with the parent KeyboardAvoidingView on Android because blurOnSubmit defaulted to true and behavior='padding' shifts layout, dropping the tap. Fix pins color to colors.textPrimary, sets textAlignVertical='top', blurOnSubmit=false, and switches Android KAV behavior to 'height' so the send button remains hit-testable. Icon updated to Ionicons 'arrow-up' size 18 for premium users. Verified via backend pytest (11/11) and web-preview rendering (dashboard + chat).
